english: own (his/her own — points back to the subject)
notes: Contrast atani "his" = someone else's. Ravi tana pustakaṁ = his own book; Ravi atani pustakaṁ = someone else's.
reason: The merged gloss said "his", which came from the English frequency list. tana is the reflexive — using it for any "his" is the exact mistake the word exists to prevent.
Telugu has no definite article. "the = ది" is an artefact of translating an English frequency list word by word.
